_description: Tracks improvement scores across automated cycles. Each cycle adds an entry with dimension scores (0-100).

cycles.root_cause: _labor_rate_specificity_penalty incorrectly penalized SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS (2.0 penalty) because 'Unemployment, total (% of total labor force)' lacks the word 'rate'. The penalty system didn't recognize '% of labor force' as equivalent to 'rate'.
cycles.fix_description: 1) Fixed _labor_rate_specificity_penalty to recognize '% of labor force' indicators as equivalent to 'rate'. Penalty dropped from 2.0 to 0.45. 2) Expanded FTS5 query normalization: 'unemployment' now includes 'total' and 'labor force' terms. 3) Added aggregate indicator boost in _rank_results: total/aggregate indicators ranked higher than youth/gender/age-bracket variants.
queries_improved: Resolution path for acc-02, acc-09, mc-05 — plausibility check now passes
cycles.note: Direct testing confirms: penalty fixed (2.0→0.45), plausibility passes (True), resolver finds SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS with 0.85 confidence. Full end-to-end query still fails due to upstream flow issue (query goes through orchestrator or prefetch check differently in live server). Root cause identified, fix verified in unit tests — remaining issue is flow integration.
